---
title: "All_WR_RTE_Analysis"
output: html_document
---

EDA / analysis of route threat efficiency (RTE) for every WR in `all_wr_play_coverage_efficiency.csv`.

Metric definitions (same as the Top-20 analysis):

* **mRTE** = median `peak_frame_efficiency` per receiver x route group
* **aRTE** = median `avg_play_efficiency`
* **fRTE** = median `final_frame_efficiency`
* **mOFC** = median `peak_frame_ofc` per receiver x route group (offensive field control)
* **aOFC** = median `avg_play_ofc`
* **fOFC** = median `final_frame_ofc`
* Percentiles compare a receiver's median against every WR route of the same route group in the dataset.

**OFC** is built exactly like RTE (sum over the target-zone cells in each frame, then peak / average / final across the play's frames) but uses only the field control model: no field value model, no EPA. Wherever an RTE metric is analyzed below, the three OFC metrics are analyzed identically, so RTE and OFC can be compared directly (and both against separation). Colors: green = RTE, orange = OFC, blue = separation, grey = prior outcome.

# 0. Setup and config

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

# default figure size for the knitted HTML (faceted plots now carry RTE and OFC rows)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width = 12, fig.height = 9)

CFG <- list(
  # ---- paths ----
  data_dir   = "~/Documents/Football_R/CMSAC--Field Value/",
  full_data  = "full_data.csv",
  pbp_file   = "PBP_Efficiency/all_wr_play_coverage_efficiency.csv",
  meta_cache = "all_wr_route_meta.rds",     # cache of the full_data join (built once)
  rebuild_meta = FALSE,                     # TRUE = rebuild the cache from full_data.csv
  out_dir    = "~/Documents/Football_R/CMSAC--Field Value/Analysis/all_wr_figs",

  # ---- route groups ----
  route_groups = c("Short", "Medium", "Long", "Ultra-Long"),
  # ONLY used if full_data has no route_group column: [-Inf,5) [5,10) [10,20) [20,Inf)
  depth_breaks = c(-Inf, 5, 12, 20, Inf),

  # ---- sample-size rules ----
  min_routes_split = 20,    # per season half, per route group (split-half correlations)
  min_wr_corr      = 15,    # drop a route group from the matrix if fewer WRs qualify
  min_routes_table = 25,    # top-10 tables
  min_routes_model = 30,    # scatterplots + regressions
  min_n_model      = 12,    # skip a regression if fewer WRs than this

  # ---- misc ----
  split_method = "season",  # "season" = league-wide midpoint of the schedule
                            # "player" = each WR's own median game (old Top-20 approach)
  top_n = 10
)

OUT_DIR <- path.expand(CFG$out_dir)
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# shared look
RTE_PALETTE <- c("#D73027", "#FFFFBF", "#1A9850")

# Metric families. RTE = field control x field value; OFC = field control only.
# Every analysis below loops over FIELD_METRICS (plus separation where it is a benchmark).
METRIC_FAMILIES <- list(RTE = c("mRTE", "aRTE", "fRTE"), OFC = c("mOFC", "aOFC", "fOFC"))
FIELD_METRICS   <- unlist(METRIC_FAMILIES, use.names = FALSE)   # mRTE aRTE fRTE mOFC aOFC fOFC
ALL_FEATS       <- c(FIELD_METRICS, "separation")
metric_family   <- function(m) {
  case_when(m %in% METRIC_FAMILIES$OFC ~ "OFC",
            m == "separation"          ~ "Separation",
            m == "prior"               ~ "Prior outcome (H1)",
            TRUE                       ~ "RTE")
}
FAMILY_COLORS <- c(RTE = "#1A9850", OFC = "#E08214", Separation = "#4575B4",
                   `Prior outcome (H1)` = "#999999")

theme_rte <- function() {
  theme_minimal() +
    theme(text = element_text(face = "bold"),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}
```

# 1. Build the play-level analysis table

Everything not in the efficiency CSV is derived from `full_data.csv`, once, and cached:

* `player_role`, `pass_result`: targets and catches
* `route_depth`, `route_group`: used as-is if they exist in `full_data`; otherwise derived (see `build_route_meta`)
* `separation`: distance (yards) from the WR to the closest defender in the **last pre-pass frame** (time of throw), computed for every route

```{r data-prep}
build_route_meta <- function(cfg, wr_ids) {
  path   <- file.path(path.expand(cfg$data_dir), cfg$full_data)
  header <- names(readr::read_csv(path, n_max = 0, show_col_types = FALSE))

  required <- c("game_id", "play_id", "frame_id", "nfl_id", "player_side", "player_role",
                "phase", "x_std", "y_std", "los_x_std", "pass_result")
  optional <- c("route_depth", "route_group", "ball_land_x_std")

  missing_req <- setdiff(required, header)
  if (length(missing_req) > 0) {
    stop("full_data is missing required columns: ", paste(missing_req, collapse = ", "))
  }

  raw <- readr::read_csv(path, col_select = dplyr::any_of(c(required, optional)),
                         show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE)
  pre <- raw %>%
    filter(phase == "pre_pass", !is.na(nfl_id), !is.na(x_std), !is.na(y_std))
  rm(raw); invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE))

  # Time of throw = last pre_pass frame of each play
  throw <- pre %>%
    group_by(game_id, play_id) %>%
    filter(frame_id == max(frame_id)) %>%
    ungroup()

  # --- traditional separation: nearest defender at the throw frame ---
  off <- throw %>%
    filter(tolower(player_side) == "offense", nfl_id %in% wr_ids) %>%
    select(game_id, play_id, nfl_id, x_std, y_std)
  def <- throw %>%
    filter(tolower(player_side) == "defense") %>%
    select(game_id, play_id, dx = x_std, dy = y_std)

  separation <- off %>%
    inner_join(def, by = c("game_id", "play_id"), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    mutate(d = sqrt((x_std - dx)^2 + (y_std - dy)^2)) %>%
    group_by(game_id, play_id, nfl_id) %>%
    summarize(separation = min(d), .groups = "drop")

  # --- per-route metadata at the throw frame ---
  meta <- throw %>%
    filter(nfl_id %in% wr_ids) %>%
    select(game_id, play_id, nfl_id, player_role, pass_result, los_x_std, any_of(optional))

  # --- route_depth fallback (only if full_data has none) ---
  if (!"route_depth" %in% names(meta)) {
    message("route_depth not found in full_data: deriving it. ",
            "Targets = ball landing depth (if ball_land_x_std exists), otherwise max depth reached pre-pass.")
    max_depth <- pre %>%
      filter(nfl_id %in% wr_ids) %>%
      group_by(game_id, play_id, nfl_id) %>%
      summarize(max_depth = max(x_std - los_x_std, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
    meta <- left_join(meta, max_depth, by = c("game_id", "play_id", "nfl_id"))

    is_tgt <- coalesce(meta$player_role == "Targeted Receiver", FALSE)
    if ("ball_land_x_std" %in% names(meta)) {
      meta$route_depth <- if_else(is_tgt & !is.na(meta$ball_land_x_std),
                                  meta$ball_land_x_std - meta$los_x_std, meta$max_depth)
    } else {
      meta$route_depth <- meta$max_depth
    }
  }

  # --- route_group fallback ---
  if (!"route_group" %in% names(meta)) {
    message("route_group not found in full_data: cutting route_depth at ",
            paste(cfg$depth_breaks[-c(1, length(cfg$depth_breaks))], collapse = " / "), " yards.")
    meta$route_group <- as.character(cut(meta$route_depth, breaks = cfg$depth_breaks,
                                         labels = cfg$route_groups, right = FALSE))
  }

  meta %>%
    select(game_id, play_id, nfl_id, player_role, pass_result, route_depth, route_group) %>%
    mutate(route_group = as.character(route_group)) %>%
    left_join(separation, by = c("game_id", "play_id", "nfl_id"))
}

load_plays <- function(cfg) {
  pbp <- readr::read_csv(file.path(path.expand(cfg$data_dir), cfg$pbp_file), show_col_types = FALSE)

  need_ofc <- c("peak_frame_ofc", "avg_play_ofc", "final_frame_ofc")
  if (!all(need_ofc %in% names(pbp))) {
    stop("The efficiency CSV has no OFC columns (", paste(setdiff(need_ofc, names(pbp)), collapse = ", "),
         "). Re-run All_WR_Cov_Eff.R (the version that writes OFC) and point CFG$pbp_file at its output.")
  }

  cache <- file.path(path.expand(cfg$data_dir), cfg$meta_cache)
  if (file.exists(cache) && !cfg$rebuild_meta) {
    message("Using cached route metadata: ", cache)
    meta <- readRDS(cache)
  } else {
    meta <- build_route_meta(cfg, wr_ids = unique(pbp$nfl_id))
    saveRDS(meta, cache)
  }

  plays <- pbp %>%
    left_join(meta, by = c("game_id", "play_id", "nfl_id")) %>%
    mutate(
      is_target = coalesce(player_role == "Targeted Receiver", FALSE),
      is_catch  = is_target & coalesce(pass_result == "C", FALSE),
      air_gain  = if_else(is_catch, route_depth, 0, missing = 0)   # air yards credited on catches only
    )

  n_drop <- sum(is.na(plays$route_group) | !plays$route_group %in% cfg$route_groups)
  if (n_drop > 0) message(n_drop, " WR-plays have no usable route_group and are dropped.")

  plays %>%
    filter(route_group %in% cfg$route_groups) %>%
    mutate(route_group = factor(route_group, levels = cfg$route_groups))
}

plays <- load_plays(CFG)

# ---- sanity checks: eyeball these before trusting anything below ----
plays %>%
  group_by(route_group) %>%
  summarize(routes = n(), wrs = n_distinct(nfl_id), targets = sum(is_target),
            catches = sum(is_catch), med_depth = median(route_depth, na.rm = TRUE),
            med_separation = median(separation, na.rm = TRUE),
            pct_missing_sep = mean(is.na(separation)), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r season-rte}
# One row per receiver x route group, season-long
summarize_season <- function(plays) {
  plays %>%
    group_by(nfl_id, player_name, route_group) %>%
    summarize(
      mRTE_raw   = median(peak_frame_efficiency),
      aRTE_raw   = median(avg_play_efficiency),
      fRTE_raw   = median(final_frame_efficiency),
      mOFC_raw   = median(peak_frame_ofc),
      aOFC_raw   = median(avg_play_ofc),
      fOFC_raw   = median(final_frame_ofc),
      separation = median(separation, na.rm = TRUE),
      routes     = n(),
      targets    = sum(is_target),
      catches    = sum(is_catch),
      air_yds    = sum(air_gain),
      .groups    = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(target_rate = targets / routes)
}

# Convert raw medians to percentiles within the route group (play-level ECDF over all WR routes)
add_percentiles <- function(season, plays) {
  pctl <- function(raw, grp, col) {
    out <- rep(NA_real_, length(raw))
    for (g in unique(as.character(grp))) {
      f   <- ecdf(plays[[col]][as.character(plays$route_group) == g])
      idx <- as.character(grp) == g
      out[idx] <- f(raw[idx]) * 100
    }
    out
  }
  season %>%
    mutate(
      mRTE = pctl(mRTE_raw, route_group, "peak_frame_efficiency"),
      aRTE = pctl(aRTE_raw, route_group, "avg_play_efficiency"),
      fRTE = pctl(fRTE_raw, route_group, "final_frame_efficiency"),
      mOFC = pctl(mOFC_raw, route_group, "peak_frame_ofc"),
      aOFC = pctl(aOFC_raw, route_group, "avg_play_ofc"),
      fOFC = pctl(fOFC_raw, route_group, "final_frame_ofc")
    )
}

season_rte <- plays %>% summarize_season() %>% add_percentiles(plays)
```

# 2. Split-half reliability of RTE and OFC

WRs need at least `min_routes_split` routes of a route group in **each** half. Route groups with fewer than `min_wr_corr` qualifying WRs are dropped automatically (expected for Ultra-Long). Correlations use raw medians; Spearman (equivalent to percentile ranks) and the Spearman-Brown full-length estimate are printed as well.

```{r split-half}
assign_half <- function(plays, method) {
  if (method == "season") {
    cutoff <- median(unique(plays$game_id))   # game_id is date-ordered (yyyymmddNN)
    plays %>% mutate(half = if_else(game_id <= cutoff, "H1", "H2"))
  } else {
    plays %>%
      group_by(nfl_id) %>%
      mutate(half = if_else(game_id <= median(game_id), "H1", "H2")) %>%
      ungroup()
  }
}

split_half_cor <- function(plays, cfg) {
  metrics <- FIELD_METRICS

  halves <- assign_half(plays, cfg$split_method) %>%
    group_by(nfl_id, player_name, route_group, half) %>%
    summarize(mRTE = median(peak_frame_efficiency),
              aRTE = median(avg_play_efficiency),
              fRTE = median(final_frame_efficiency),
              mOFC = median(peak_frame_ofc),
              aOFC = median(avg_play_ofc),
              fOFC = median(final_frame_ofc),
              routes = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = half, values_from = c(all_of(FIELD_METRICS), routes),
                names_glue = "{.value}_{half}") %>%
    filter(routes_H1 >= cfg$min_routes_split, routes_H2 >= cfg$min_routes_split)

  res <- map_dfr(cfg$route_groups, function(g) {
    d <- halves %>% filter(route_group == g)
    map_dfr(metrics, function(m) {
      a <- d[[paste0(m, "_H1")]]
      b <- d[[paste0(m, "_H2")]]
      ok <- nrow(d) >= 3
      tibble(route_group = g, metric = m, n = nrow(d),
             r   = if (ok) cor(a, b) else NA_real_,
             rho = if (ok) cor(a, b, method = "spearman") else NA_real_)
    })
  }) %>%
    mutate(r_spearman_brown = 2 * r / (1 + r))

  dropped <- res %>% filter(n < cfg$min_wr_corr) %>% pull(route_group) %>% unique()
  if (length(dropped) > 0) {
    message("Dropped from the split-half matrix (fewer than ", cfg$min_wr_corr,
            " WRs with >= ", cfg$min_routes_split, " routes in each half): ",
            paste(dropped, collapse = ", "))
  }
  res %>% filter(n >= cfg$min_wr_corr)
}

split_half <- split_half_cor(plays, CFG)
split_half %>% mutate(across(c(r, rho, r_spearman_brown), ~ round(.x, 3)))
```

```{r split-half-plot}
keep_groups <- CFG$route_groups[CFG$route_groups %in% split_half$route_group]

split_half_plot <- split_half %>%
  mutate(route_group = factor(route_group, levels = keep_groups),
         metric      = factor(metric, levels = rev(FIELD_METRICS))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(route_group, metric, fill = r)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f\n(n = %d)", r, n)), size = 3.6, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = RTE_PALETTE[1], mid = RTE_PALETTE[2], high = RTE_PALETTE[3],
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1)) +

       subtitle = paste0("Min ", CFG$min_routes_split, " routes of the route group in each half | ",
                         if (CFG$split_method == "season") "league-wide season midpoint" else "per-WR median game"),
       x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Split-half r") +
  theme_rte()

ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "rte_split_half_corr.png"), split_half_plot, width = 8, height = 5.4)
```

# 3. RTE and OFC vs. air receiving yards

Season air receiving yards in each route group (route depth credited on catches) against the three RTE and the three OFC percentiles. Total air yards also scale with routes run, so a per-route version follows.

```{r rte-vs-air}
model_df <- season_rte %>%
  filter(routes >= CFG$min_routes_model)

rte_long <- model_df %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(FIELD_METRICS), names_to = "metric", values_to = "pctl") %>%
  mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = FIELD_METRICS),
         family = metric_family(as.character(metric)),
         air_yds_per_route = air_yds / routes)

plot_rte_vs_air <- function(df, yvar, ylab, title, file) {
  labs_df <- df %>%
    group_by(route_group, metric) %>%
    summarize(r = cor(pctl, .data[[yvar]], use = "complete.obs"), n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(label = sprintf("r = %.2f\nn = %d", r, n))

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(pctl, .data[[yvar]])) +
    geom_point(aes(color = family), alpha = 0.75, size = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = FAMILY_COLORS, guide = "none") +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE, color = "#D73027",
                fill = "#D73027", alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_text(data = labs_df, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
              hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.2, size = 3.2, fontface = "bold", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    facet_grid(metric ~ route_group, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
    labs(title = title,
         subtitle = paste0("Each point = one WR | min ", CFG$min_routes_model, " routes in the route group"),
         x = "Percentile within route group", y = ylab) +
    theme_rte()

  ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, file), p, width = 12, height = 12)
  p
}

plot_rte_vs_air(rte_long, "air_yds", "Air receiving yards (season)",
                "RTE and OFC vs. air receiving yards by route group", "rte_vs_air_yards.png")

plot_rte_vs_air(rte_long, "air_yds_per_route", "Air receiving yards per route",
                "RTE and OFC vs. air receiving yards per route", "rte_vs_air_yards_per_route.png")
```

# 4. Top-10 mRTE and mOFC tables by route group

Each route group gets a table ranked by mRTE and an identical one ranked by mOFC (field control only), with the same ancillary stats.

```{r top10-tables}
player_tgt_totals <- plays %>%
  group_by(nfl_id) %>%
  summarize(player_targets_all = sum(is_target), .groups = "drop")

make_top_table <- function(group, metric = "mRTE", n = CFG$top_n, min_routes = CFG$min_routes_table, save = TRUE) {
  stopifnot(metric %in% c("mRTE", "mOFC"))
  primary   <- metric                                          # ranked by this metric's raw median
  secondary <- if (metric == "mRTE") "aRTE" else "aOFC"
  raw_col   <- paste0(metric, "_raw")

  tab <- season_rte %>%
    filter(route_group == group, routes >= min_routes) %>%
    left_join(player_tgt_totals, by = "nfl_id") %>%
    mutate(
      tgt_share   = if_else(player_targets_all > 0, targets / player_targets_all, 0),  # % of player's own targets
      comp_pct    = if_else(targets > 0, catches / targets, NA_real_),
      yds_per_tgt = if_else(targets > 0, air_yds / targets, NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(.data[[raw_col]])) %>%
    slice_head(n = n) %>%
    select(player_name, pctl_1 = all_of(primary), pctl_2 = all_of(secondary),
           targets, tgt_share, comp_pct, yds_per_tgt)

  gt_tbl <- tab %>%
    gt() %>%
    tab_header(
      title    = md(paste0("**Top ", n, " ", primary, ": ", group, " Routes (2023)**")),
      subtitle = md(paste0(primary, " / ", secondary, ": Median route percentile vs. all WR routes of the same depth",
                           if (metric == "mOFC") " (field control only, no field value model)" else "",
                           " | min ", min_routes, " routes"))
    ) %>%
    cols_label(player_name = "Player", pctl_1 = primary, pctl_2 = secondary, targets = "Targets",
               tgt_share = "% of Player's Targets", comp_pct = "Comp %",
               yds_per_tgt = "Air Rec Yds / Tgt") %>%
    fmt_number(columns = c(pctl_1, pctl_2, yds_per_tgt), decimals = 1) %>%
    fmt_number(columns = targets, decimals = 0) %>%
    fmt_percent(columns = c(tgt_share, comp_pct), decimals = 1) %>%
    sub_missing(columns = c(comp_pct, yds_per_tgt), missing_text = "—") %>%
    data_color(columns = c(pctl_1, pctl_2), palette = RTE_PALETTE, domain = c(0, 100), na_color = "#EEEEEE") %>%
    cols_align(align = "left", columns = player_name) %>%
    cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(pctl_1, pctl_2, targets, tgt_share, comp_pct, yds_per_tgt)) %>%
    opt_row_striping() %>%
    tab_options(table.font.size = px(13), heading.title.font.size = px(16),
                column_labels.font.weight = "bold")

  if (save) gtsave(gt_tbl, filename = file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0("top", n, "_", metric, "_", group, "_2023.png")))
  gt_tbl
}

make_top_table("Short",      "mRTE")
make_top_table("Medium",     "mRTE")
make_top_table("Long",       "mRTE")
make_top_table("Ultra-Long", "mRTE")

make_top_table("Short",      "mOFC")
make_top_table("Medium",     "mOFC")
make_top_table("Long",       "mOFC")
make_top_table("Ultra-Long", "mOFC")
```

# 5. Are RTE and OFC better predictors of air receiving yards than separation?

For each route group, one linear model per feature, all fit on the same WRs:

* **Baseline:** `air_yds ~ routes`
* **Additive:** `air_yds ~ routes + feature`
* **Interaction:** `air_yds ~ routes * feature`
* Features: `mRTE`, `aRTE`, `fRTE`, `mOFC`, `aOFC`, `fOFC` (percentiles) and `separation` (median yards to the nearest defender at throw, over all routes in the group). Features are z-scored so `beta_z` is the change in air yards per +1 SD.
* Comparison metrics: adjusted R², leave-one-out RMSE (`loocv_rmse`, the honest out-of-sample number), AIC, and an F-test against the routes-only baseline.

```{r regression}
fit_group_models <- function(d, g, cfg) {
  d <- d %>%
    drop_na(air_yds, routes, all_of(ALL_FEATS)) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(ALL_FEATS), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x))))

  if (nrow(d) < cfg$min_n_model) {
    message("Skipping ", g, ": only ", nrow(d), " WRs (need ", cfg$min_n_model, ").")
    return(NULL)
  }

  base      <- lm(air_yds ~ routes, data = d)
  base_adj  <- summary(base)$adj.r.squared
  loocv     <- function(fit) sqrt(mean((residuals(fit) / (1 - hatvalues(fit)))^2))

  one <- function(feature, form) {
    f   <- if (form == "Additive") paste("air_yds ~ routes +", feature)
           else                    paste("air_yds ~ routes *", feature)
    fit <- lm(as.formula(f), data = d)
    adj <- summary(fit)$adj.r.squared
    tibble(route_group = g, feature = feature, form = form, n = nobs(fit),
           adj_r2 = adj, d_adj_r2 = adj - base_adj,
           loocv_rmse = loocv(fit), aic = AIC(fit),
           p_vs_routes_only = anova(base, fit)[2, "Pr(>F)"],
           beta_z = if (form == "Additive") unname(coef(fit)[feature]) else NA_real_)
  }

  grid <- expand_grid(feature = ALL_FEATS,
                      form    = c("Additive", "Interaction"))

  bind_rows(
    tibble(route_group = g, feature = "routes only", form = "Baseline", n = nobs(base),
           adj_r2 = base_adj, d_adj_r2 = 0, loocv_rmse = loocv(base), aic = AIC(base),
           p_vs_routes_only = NA_real_, beta_z = NA_real_),
    bind_rows(pmap(grid, one))
  )
}

model_results <- map_dfr(CFG$route_groups, function(g) {
  fit_group_models(model_df %>% filter(route_group == g), g, CFG)
}) %>%
  mutate(route_group = factor(route_group, levels = CFG$route_groups),
         type = if_else(feature == "routes only", "Baseline", metric_family(feature))) %>%
  group_by(route_group, form) %>%
  mutate(rank_loocv = if_else(form == "Baseline", NA_integer_, as.integer(rank(loocv_rmse)))) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# 6. Follow-ups

Added after the original analysis; like the sections above, every block here now runs the three OFC metrics next to the three RTE metrics. These blocks reuse `plays`, `season_rte`, `split_half`, `assign_half()`, `summarize_season()`, `add_percentiles()`, `CFG`, `OUT_DIR`, `theme_rte()` and `RTE_PALETTE`, so run the chunks above first.

```{r followup-setup}
CFG_FU <- list(
  min_targets_season = 10,  # 6b: WR needs >= this many targets in the route group (full season)
  min_targets_half   = 5    # 6c: per-target outcome needs >= this many targets in EACH half
)

FEATURE_LABELS <- c(baseline = "baseline (no feature)", mRTE = "mRTE", aRTE = "aRTE", fRTE = "fRTE",
                    mOFC = "mOFC", aOFC = "aOFC", fOFC = "fOFC",
                    separation = "separation", prior = "prior outcome (H1)")

# feature order / axis labels for the skill bar charts (6c, 6f)
FEATURE_LEVELS      <- c(ALL_FEATS, "prior")
FEATURE_AXIS_LABELS <- c(FIELD_METRICS, "separation", "prior outcome")

# Weighted Pearson correlation (weights = targets, so low-target WRs count less)
wcor <- function(x, y, w) {
  ok <- complete.cases(x, y, w)
  if (sum(ok) < 3) return(NA_real_)
  cov.wt(cbind(x[ok], y[ok]), wt = w[ok] / sum(w[ok]), cor = TRUE)$cor[1, 2]
}

# Leave-one-out RMSE via the hat-matrix shortcut. Works for lm() with or without weights
# (residuals() are raw residuals, hatvalues() uses the weighted hat matrix);
# the average is weighted by w so it matches how the model is fit.
loo_rmse_w <- function(fit, w) {
  e <- residuals(fit) / (1 - hatvalues(fit))
  sqrt(weighted.mean(e^2, w))
}
```

## 6a. Split-half reliability of the benchmarks: separation and air yards per route

Same rules as section 2 (same halves, WRs need at least `min_routes_split` routes of the route group in each half, same `min_wr_corr` rule), so the n's match the RTE rows and the numbers are directly comparable. The RTE rows are taken from `split_half` above.

```{r followup-benchmark-reliability}
bench_split_half <- function(plays, cfg) {
  halves <- assign_half(plays, cfg$split_method) %>%
    group_by(nfl_id, player_name, route_group, half) %>%
    summarize(separation        = median(separation, na.rm = TRUE),
              air_yds_per_route = sum(air_gain) / n(),
              routes            = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = half, values_from = c(separation, air_yds_per_route, routes),
                names_glue = "{.value}_{half}") %>%
    filter(routes_H1 >= cfg$min_routes_split, routes_H2 >= cfg$min_routes_split)

  metrics <- c("separation", "air_yds_per_route")

  map_dfr(cfg$route_groups, function(g) {
    d <- halves %>% filter(route_group == g)
    map_dfr(metrics, function(m) {
      a  <- d[[paste0(m, "_H1")]]
      b  <- d[[paste0(m, "_H2")]]
      ok <- complete.cases(a, b)
      tibble(route_group = g, metric = m, n = sum(ok),
             r   = if (sum(ok) >= 3) cor(a[ok], b[ok]) else NA_real_,
             rho = if (sum(ok) >= 3) cor(a[ok], b[ok], method = "spearman") else NA_real_)
    })
  }) %>%
    mutate(r_spearman_brown = 2 * r / (1 + r)) %>%
    filter(n >= cfg$min_wr_corr)
}

METRIC_LABELS <- c(mRTE = "mRTE", aRTE = "aRTE", fRTE = "fRTE",
                   mOFC = "mOFC", aOFC = "aOFC", fOFC = "fOFC",
                   separation = "Separation", air_yds_per_route = "Air yds / route")

reliability_all <- bind_rows(
  split_half %>% select(route_group, metric, n, r, rho, r_spearman_brown),
  bench_split_half(plays, CFG)
)

reliability_all %>%
  mutate(across(c(r, rho, r_spearman_brown), ~ round(.x, 3)))
```

```{r followup-benchmark-reliability-plot}

reliability_plot <- reliability_all %>%
  mutate(route_group = factor(route_group, levels = keep_rel),
         metric      = factor(metric, levels = rev(names(METRIC_LABELS)),
                              labels = rev(unname(METRIC_LABELS)))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(route_group, metric, fill = r)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f\n(n = %d)", r, n)), size = 3.6, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = RTE_PALETTE[1], mid = RTE_PALETTE[2], high = RTE_PALETTE[3],
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Split-half reliability: RTE vs. OFC vs. separation vs. air yards per route",
       subtitle = paste0("Min ", CFG$min_routes_split, " routes of the route group in each half | ",
                         if (CFG$split_method == "season") "league-wide season midpoint" else "per-WR median game"),
       x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Split-half r") +
  theme_rte()

ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "split_half_reliability_benchmarks.png"), reliability_plot, width = 8, height = 6.4)
```

## 6b. Air receiving yards per target (full season)

Outcome = `air_yds / targets` in the route group (air yards are credited on catches, so this is the same quantity as "Air Rec Yds / Tgt" in the top-10 tables). Because the outcome is already a rate, routes run is not a control. Each model is `air_yds_per_target ~ feature` fit by **weighted** least squares (weights = targets, since a WR with 30 targets gives a much less noisy rate than one with 10), compared with an intercept-only baseline. Features are z-scored, so `beta_z` = change in air yards per target for +1 SD of the feature. `LOO skill` = 1 - (LOO MSE of the model / LOO MSE of the baseline); positive means the feature beats the baseline out of sample. WRs need `min_routes_model` routes and `min_targets_season` targets in the route group; groups with fewer than `min_n_model` WRs are skipped (expect Ultra-Long to drop out).

```{r followup-ayt-models}
fit_ayt_models <- function(d, g, cfg, fu) {
  d <- d %>%
    filter(targets >= fu$min_targets_season) %>%
    mutate(ayt = air_yds / targets) %>%
    drop_na(ayt, all_of(ALL_FEATS)) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(ALL_FEATS), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x))))

  if (nrow(d) < cfg$min_n_model) {
    message("6b: skipping ", g, ": only ", nrow(d), " WRs with >= ", fu$min_targets_season,
            " targets (need ", cfg$min_n_model, ").")
    return(NULL)
  }

  base      <- lm(ayt ~ 1, data = d, weights = targets)
  base_loo  <- loo_rmse_w(base, d$targets)

  one <- function(feature) {
    fit <- lm(as.formula(paste("ayt ~", feature)), data = d, weights = targets)
    loo <- loo_rmse_w(fit, d$targets)
    tibble(route_group = g, feature = feature, n = nobs(fit),
           adj_r2 = summary(fit)$adj.r.squared,
           loocv_rmse = loo, loo_skill = 1 - (loo / base_loo)^2,
           p_vs_base = anova(base, fit)[2, "Pr(>F)"],
           beta_z = unname(coef(fit)[feature]),
           r_weighted = wcor(d[[feature]], d$ayt, d$targets))
  }

  bind_rows(
    tibble(route_group = g, feature = "baseline", n = nobs(base),
           adj_r2 = summary(base)$adj.r.squared, loocv_rmse = base_loo, loo_skill = 0,
           p_vs_base = NA_real_, beta_z = NA_real_, r_weighted = NA_real_),
    map_dfr(ALL_FEATS, one)
  )
}

ayt_results <- map_dfr(CFG$route_groups, function(g) {
  fit_ayt_models(season_rte %>% filter(route_group == g, routes >= CFG$min_routes_model),
                 g, CFG, CFG_FU)
})
stopifnot("6b: no route group had enough WRs" = nrow(ayt_results) > 0)

ayt_results <- ayt_results %>%
  mutate(route_group = factor(route_group, levels = CFG$route_groups))
```

```{r followup-ayt-table}
  gt(groupname_col = "route_group") %>%
  tab_header(
    title    = md("**Predicting air receiving yards per target by route group**"),
    subtitle = md(paste0("Weighted least squares (weights = targets) | min ", CFG_FU$min_targets_season,
                         " targets in the route group | 2023"))
```

## 6c. Out-of-sample: first-half features predicting second-half outcomes

Features come only from the **first half** of the season; outcomes come only from the **second half**, so RTE and the outcome never share a play. To keep it strictly out of sample, RTE percentiles are recomputed from first-half plays only (the pooled-season ECDF in section 1 includes second-half plays). Three outcomes:

* **Air yds per route (H2):** `ayr_h2 ~ feature_H1`, weighted by H2 routes, vs. an intercept-only baseline. This keeps usage (target rate) in the outcome, so a feature can earn skill by predicting who gets targeted as well as what happens on a target. No target minimum is needed.
* **Air yds per target (H2):** `ayt_h2 ~ feature_H1`, weighted by H2 targets, vs. an intercept-only baseline. WRs need at least `min_targets_half` targets in each half.
* **Total air yds (H2):** `air_yds_h2 ~ routes_h2 + feature_H1` vs. `air_yds_h2 ~ routes_h2`. This uses H2 routes as a volume control, so it is not a pure forecast.

Features are `mRTE`, `aRTE`, `fRTE`, `mOFC`, `aOFC`, `fOFC`, `separation` (all first half) and `prior`: the first-half value of the *outcome itself* (the usual persistence benchmark: does RTE tell you anything the WR's own past production doesn't?). WRs need `min_routes_split` routes of the route group in each half. Every model in a group/outcome is fit on the same WRs. `LOO skill` is computed across WRs (leave one WR out), relative to the baseline.

```{r followup-oos-models}
OOS_SPECS <- list(
  ayr = list(label = "Air yds per route (H2)", y = "ayr_h2", controls = character(0),
             prior = "ayr_h1", weight = "routes_h2", needs_targets = FALSE),
  ayt = list(label = "Air yds per target (H2)", y = "ayt_h2", controls = character(0),
             prior = "ayt_h1", weight = "targets_h2", needs_targets = TRUE),
  air_yds = list(label = "Total air yds (H2)", y = "air_yds_h2", controls = "routes_h2",
                 prior = "air_yds_h1", weight = NULL, needs_targets = FALSE)
)

build_oos_data <- function(plays, cfg) {
  p  <- assign_half(plays, cfg$split_method)
  p1 <- p %>% filter(half == "H1")
  p2 <- p %>% filter(half == "H2")

  h1 <- summarize_season(p1) %>%
    add_percentiles(p1) %>%                      # percentiles from H1 plays only
    transmute(nfl_id, player_name, route_group, routes_h1 = routes, across(all_of(FIELD_METRICS)),
              separation, targets_h1 = targets, air_yds_h1 = air_yds)

  h2 <- summarize_season(p2) %>%
    transmute(nfl_id, route_group, routes_h2 = routes, targets_h2 = targets, air_yds_h2 = air_yds)

  inner_join(h1, h2, by = c("nfl_id", "route_group")) %>%
    filter(routes_h1 >= cfg$min_routes_split, routes_h2 >= cfg$min_routes_split) %>%
    mutate(ayt_h1 = if_else(targets_h1 > 0, air_yds_h1 / targets_h1, NA_real_),
           ayt_h2 = if_else(targets_h2 > 0, air_yds_h2 / targets_h2, NA_real_),
           ayr_h1 = air_yds_h1 / routes_h1,
           ayr_h2 = air_yds_h2 / routes_h2)
}

fit_oos_models <- function(d, g, spec, cfg, fu) {
  if (spec$needs_targets) {
    d <- d %>% filter(targets_h1 >= fu$min_targets_half, targets_h2 >= fu$min_targets_half)
  }
  feats <- c(ALL_FEATS, "prior")

  d <- d %>%
    mutate(prior = .data[[spec$prior]]) %>%
    drop_na(all_of(c(spec$y, spec$controls, feats)))

  if (nrow(d) < cfg$min_n_model) {
    message("6c: skipping ", g, " / ", spec$label, ": only ", nrow(d), " WRs (need ", cfg$min_n_model, ").")
    return(NULL)
  }

  d <- d %>% mutate(across(all_of(feats), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x))))
  d$wt_ <- if (is.null(spec$weight)) 1 else d[[spec$weight]]

  rhs  <- function(feature = NULL) {
    terms <- c(spec$controls, feature)
    if (length(terms) == 0) "1" else paste(terms, collapse = " + ")
  }
  make_fit <- function(feature = NULL) {
    lm(as.formula(paste(spec$y, "~", rhs(feature))), data = d, weights = wt_)
  }

  base     <- make_fit()
  base_loo <- loo_rmse_w(base, d$wt_)

  one <- function(feature) {
    fit <- make_fit(feature)
    loo <- loo_rmse_w(fit, d$wt_)
    tibble(route_group = g, outcome = spec$label, feature = feature, n = nobs(fit),
           adj_r2 = summary(fit)$adj.r.squared,
           loocv_rmse = loo, loo_skill = 1 - (loo / base_loo)^2,
           p_vs_base = anova(base, fit)[2, "Pr(>F)"],
           beta_z = unname(coef(fit)[feature]),
           r_raw = wcor(d[[feature]], d[[spec$y]], d$wt_))
  }

  bind_rows(
    tibble(route_group = g, outcome = spec$label, feature = "baseline", n = nobs(base),
           adj_r2 = summary(base)$adj.r.squared, loocv_rmse = base_loo, loo_skill = 0,
           p_vs_base = NA_real_, beta_z = NA_real_, r_raw = NA_real_),
    map_dfr(feats, one)
  )
}

oos_data <- build_oos_data(plays, CFG)
oos_data %>% count(route_group, name = "WRs_with_both_halves")   # sample sizes before outcome-specific filters

oos_results <- map_dfr(OOS_SPECS, function(spec) {
  map_dfr(CFG$route_groups, function(g) {
    fit_oos_models(oos_data %>% filter(route_group == g), g, spec, CFG, CFG_FU)
  })
})
stopifnot("6c: no route group had enough WRs" = nrow(oos_results) > 0)

oos_results <- oos_results %>%
  mutate(route_group = factor(route_group, levels = CFG$route_groups))
```

```{r followup-oos-table}
  gt(groupname_col = "group") %>%
  tab_header(
    title    = md("**First-half features predicting second-half outcomes**"),
    subtitle = md("Features and RTE percentiles from H1 plays only; outcomes from H2 plays only | 2023")
  ) %>%
  cols_label(feature = "H1 feature", n = "WRs", adj_r2 = "Adj R²", loocv_rmse = "LOO RMSE",
             loo_skill = "LOO skill vs. baseline", p_vs_base = "p vs. baseline",
             beta_z = "β (per SD)", r_raw = "r with H2 outcome") %>%

  data_color(columns = loo_skill, palette = RTE_PALETTE, domain = c(-0.1, 0.1), na_color = "#EEEEEE") %>%
  opt_row_striping() %>%
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(12), heading.title.font.size = px(16),
              column_labels.font.weight = "bold", row_group.font.weight = "bold")
```

```{r followup-oos-plot}
       x = NULL, y = "LOO skill vs. baseline", fill = NULL) +
  theme_rte() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```

## 6d. Usage check: is the negative Long relationship a target-volume effect?

Two checks, run for every route group (Long is the one to read first):

1. **Same WRs, different outcomes.** Correlate mRTE / aRTE / fRTE (and the OFC equivalents) with target rate, air yards per target, air yards per route and total air yards on (a) every WR with at least `min_routes_model` routes in the route group, and (b) only the WRs used in 6b (also at least `min_targets_season` targets). The per-target models in 6b silently dropped low-target WRs, so if the sign flip were just selection, the total and per-route correlations would shrink toward zero on sample (b). If they stay negative there, the flip comes from the denominator, not from who was dropped.
2. **RTE vs. target rate directly.** Target rate = targets / routes in the route group. Because `air yds / route = target rate x air yds / target`, the per-route correlation is made of a target-rate part and a per-target part. The usage story predicts: clearly negative with target rate, near zero per target, in between per route.

```{r followup-usage-check}
USAGE_SAMPLES <- c("All WRs (min routes)", "Same WRs as 6b (min targets)")
USAGE_OUTCOMES <- c(target_rate = "Target rate", air_yds_per_target = "Air yds / target",
                    air_yds_per_route = "Air yds / route", air_yds = "Total air yds")

usage_corr <- function(season, cfg, fu) {
  metrics <- FIELD_METRICS

  base <- season %>%
    filter(routes >= cfg$min_routes_model) %>%
    mutate(target_rate        = targets / routes,
           air_yds_per_target = if_else(targets > 0, air_yds / targets, NA_real_),
           air_yds_per_route  = air_yds / routes)

  samples <- setNames(
    list(base, base %>% filter(targets >= fu$min_targets_season)),
    USAGE_SAMPLES
  )

  imap_dfr(samples, function(d, sample_name) {
    map_dfr(cfg$route_groups, function(g) {
      dg <- d %>% filter(route_group == g)
      map_dfr(names(USAGE_OUTCOMES), function(o) {
        map_dfr(metrics, function(m) {
          ok <- complete.cases(dg[[m]], dg[[o]])
          tibble(sample = sample_name, route_group = g, outcome = USAGE_OUTCOMES[[o]],
                 metric = m, n = sum(ok),
                 r   = if (sum(ok) >= 3) cor(dg[[m]][ok], dg[[o]][ok]) else NA_real_,
                 rho = if (sum(ok) >= 3) cor(dg[[m]][ok], dg[[o]][ok], method = "spearman") else NA_real_)
        })
      })
    })
  })
}

usage_results <- usage_corr(season_rte, CFG, CFG_FU) %>%
  mutate(route_group = factor(route_group, levels = CFG$route_groups))

# Long routes: Pearson r and Spearman rho, both samples
usage_results %>%
  filter(route_group == "Long") %>%
  group_by(sample, outcome) %>%
  mutate(n = min(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(sample, outcome, n, metric, r, rho) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = c(r, rho), names_glue = "{metric} {.value}") %>%
  mutate(sample  = factor(sample, levels = USAGE_SAMPLES),
         outcome = factor(outcome, levels = unname(USAGE_OUTCOMES))) %>%
  arrange(sample, outcome) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !n, ~ round(.x, 2)))
```

## 6e. Does RTE add anything beyond past production (and usage)?

Outcome is second-half air yards per route, as in 6c, using the same WRs, first-half features and weights (H2 routes). Here every model starts from controls and asks whether a first-half feature improves out-of-sample prediction on top of them:

* **Controls = prior yds/route:** `ayr_h2 ~ ayr_h1 (+ feature)`. Does RTE or separation add anything to a WR's own first-half production?
* **Controls = prior yds/route + H1 target rate:** `ayr_h2 ~ ayr_h1 + tr_h1 (+ feature)`, where `tr_h1` = first-half targets / routes in the route group. If RTE's Long signal is just usage, it should shrink toward zero here; if it survives, RTE carries information beyond how often a WR was targeted.

`skill vs. controls` is the incremental leave-one-WR-out skill of adding the feature to the controls (same formula as 6c, with the controls-only model as the baseline). `skill vs. intercept` is the absolute skill against an intercept-only model, so the control sets can be compared with each other. Features are z-scored; `beta_z` is air yards per route per +1 SD of the feature, holding the controls fixed.

```{r followup-incremental-models}
INCR_CONTROLS <- list(
  "prior yds/route"                  = "prior",
  "prior yds/route + H1 target rate" = c("prior", "tr_h1")
)

fit_incremental <- function(d, g, control_label, controls, cfg) {
  feats <- ALL_FEATS

  d <- d %>%
    mutate(prior = ayr_h1, tr_h1 = targets_h1 / routes_h1) %>%
    drop_na(ayr_h2, all_of(c(feats, "prior", "tr_h1")))

  if (nrow(d) < cfg$min_n_model) {
    message("6e: skipping ", g, " / ", control_label, ": only ", nrow(d), " WRs (need ", cfg$min_n_model, ").")
    return(NULL)
  }

  d <- d %>% mutate(across(all_of(c(feats, "prior", "tr_h1")), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x))))
  d$wt_ <- d$routes_h2

  make_fit <- function(rhs) {
    lm(as.formula(paste("ayr_h2 ~", paste(rhs, collapse = " + "))), data = d, weights = wt_)
  }

  null_loo <- loo_rmse_w(make_fit("1"), d$wt_)
  base     <- make_fit(controls)
  base_loo <- loo_rmse_w(base, d$wt_)

  row <- function(feature, fit) {
    loo     <- loo_rmse_w(fit, d$wt_)
    is_base <- identical(feature, "controls only")
    tibble(route_group = g, controls = control_label, feature = feature, n = nobs(fit),
           adj_r2 = summary(fit)$adj.r.squared, loocv_rmse = loo,
           skill_vs_controls  = 1 - (loo / base_loo)^2,
           skill_vs_intercept = 1 - (loo / null_loo)^2,
           p_vs_controls = if (is_base) NA_real_ else anova(base, fit)[2, "Pr(>F)"],
           beta_z        = if (is_base) NA_real_ else unname(coef(fit)[feature]))
  }

  bind_rows(
    row("controls only", base),
    map_dfr(feats, function(f) row(f, make_fit(c(controls, f))))
  )
}

incr_results <- imap_dfr(INCR_CONTROLS, function(controls, label) {
  map_dfr(CFG$route_groups, function(g) {
    fit_incremental(oos_data %>% filter(route_group == g), g, label, controls, CFG)
  })
})
stopifnot("6e: no route group had enough WRs" = nrow(incr_results) > 0)

incr_results <- incr_results %>%
  mutate(route_group = factor(route_group, levels = CFG$route_groups),
         controls    = factor(controls, levels = names(INCR_CONTROLS)))
```

## 6f. Completion % and EPA per target (out of sample), alongside air yards per route

Same design as 6c (first-half features and RTE percentiles, second-half outcomes, leave-one-WR-out skill, prior-outcome benchmark), with two outcomes that exist only on targeted routes:

* **Completion % (H2):** catches / targets in the route group, weighted by H2 targets. WRs need at least `min_targets_half` targets in each half.
* **EPA per target (H2):** mean `expected_points_added` of the plays on which the WR was targeted, weighted by H2 targets. This needs a play-level EPA column in `full_data.csv`. The block looks for `expected_points_added` (or `epa`), and if neither exists it skips EPA with a message and runs completion % only. If yours is named differently, add the name to `EPA_CANDIDATES`.

Caveats: EPA is a **play-level** outcome, so it includes the QB, pass protection and yards after catch, not just the route. Completion % depends on how hard the throw was. Both only exist on targeted routes, so they describe what happens when the ball is thrown to the receiver, not how often it is.

```{r followup-extra-outcomes}
EPA_CANDIDATES <- c("expected_points_added", "epa")

load_play_epa <- function(cfg) {
  dir   <- path.expand(cfg$data_dir)
  cache <- file.path(dir, "all_wr_play_epa.rds")
  if (file.exists(cache) && !cfg$rebuild_meta) return(readRDS(cache))

  path    <- file.path(dir, cfg$full_data)
  header  <- names(readr::read_csv(path, n_max = 0, show_col_types = FALSE))
  epa_col <- intersect(EPA_CANDIDATES, header)[1]
  if (is.na(epa_col)) {
    message("6f: no EPA column found in full_data (looked for: ", paste(EPA_CANDIDATES, collapse = ", "),
            "). Skipping EPA; running completion % only.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  out <- readr::read_csv(path, col_select = dplyr::all_of(c("game_id", "play_id", epa_col)),
                         show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE) %>%
    distinct(game_id, play_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    rename(epa = all_of(epa_col))
  saveRDS(out, cache)
  out
}

build_extra_outcomes <- function(plays, play_epa, cfg) {
  p <- assign_half(plays, cfg$split_method)
  if (is.null(play_epa)) {
    p$epa <- NA_real_
  } else {
    p <- p %>% left_join(play_epa, by = c("game_id", "play_id"))
  }

  p %>%
    group_by(nfl_id, route_group, half) %>%
    summarize(tg = sum(is_target), ct = sum(is_catch),
              epa_sum = sum(if_else(is_target, epa, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
              n_epa   = sum(is_target & !is.na(epa)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = half, values_from = c(tg, ct, epa_sum, n_epa),
                names_glue = "{.value}_{half}") %>%
    transmute(nfl_id, route_group,
              comp_h1 = if_else(tg_H1 > 0, ct_H1 / tg_H1, NA_real_),
              comp_h2 = if_else(tg_H2 > 0, ct_H2 / tg_H2, NA_real_),
              epat_h1 = if_else(n_epa_H1 > 0, epa_sum_H1 / n_epa_H1, NA_real_),
              epat_h2 = if_else(n_epa_H2 > 0, epa_sum_H2 / n_epa_H2, NA_real_))
}

play_epa      <- load_play_epa(CFG)
oos_data_ext  <- oos_data %>%
  left_join(build_extra_outcomes(plays, play_epa, CFG), by = c("nfl_id", "route_group"))

EXTRA_SPECS <- list(
  comp = list(label = "Completion % (H2)", y = "comp_h2", controls = character(0),
              prior = "comp_h1", weight = "targets_h2", needs_targets = TRUE),
  epat = list(label = "EPA per target (H2)", y = "epat_h2", controls = character(0),
              prior = "epat_h1", weight = "targets_h2", needs_targets = TRUE)
)
if (is.null(play_epa)) EXTRA_SPECS$epat <- NULL

oos_results_extra <- map_dfr(EXTRA_SPECS, function(spec) {
  map_dfr(CFG$route_groups, function(g) {
    fit_oos_models(oos_data_ext %>% filter(route_group == g), g, spec, CFG, CFG_FU)
  })
})
stopifnot("6f: no route group had enough WRs" = nrow(oos_results_extra) > 0)

# Side by side with air yards per route from 6c
KEY_OUTCOMES <- c("Air yds per route (H2)", "Completion % (H2)", "EPA per target (H2)")

oos_key <- bind_rows(
```

# 7. Peak vs. average residuals: who is spiky, who is sustained?

For each receiver, the **residual** is the season peak percentile minus the season average percentile: `mRTE - aRTE` and `mOFC - aOFC`. A large positive residual means the receiver's best moment on a route is much better than his typical moment (a spiky threat that appears briefly). A large negative residual means he is comparatively better on average than at his peak (a threat that is sustained, but rarely peaks).

Receivers are scored across all route groups, so the minimum is **200 routes in total** (`CFG_RESID$min_routes`). Percentiles are the within-route-group percentiles from `season_rte`, combined into one number per receiver with a **routes-weighted average** across his route groups. That keeps the residual from being driven by route mix (Long routes are not compared to Short ones). The residual is in percentile points. Four tables: top 10 and bottom 10 for RTE, and the same two for OFC.

```{r residual-setup}
CFG_RESID <- list(min_routes = 200, n = 10)

resid_df <- season_rte %>%
  group_by(nfl_id, player_name) %>%
  summarize(across(all_of(FIELD_METRICS), ~ weighted.mean(.x, routes)),   # uses per-group routes
            targets = sum(targets),
            routes  = sum(routes),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(resid_RTE = mRTE - aRTE,
         resid_OFC = mOFC - aOFC) %>%
  filter(routes >= CFG_RESID$min_routes)

message(nrow(resid_df), " WRs with at least ", CFG_RESID$min_routes, " routes across the route groups.")

# distribution check
resid_df %>%
  summarize(across(c(resid_RTE, resid_OFC),
                   list(min = min, p25 = ~ quantile(.x, 0.25), median = median,
                        p75 = ~ quantile(.x, 0.75), max = max),
                   .names = "{.col}_{.fn}")) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = c("metric", "stat"), names_pattern = "resid_(RTE|OFC)_(.*)") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 1)))
```

```{r residual-tables}
make_resid_table <- function(family = c("RTE", "OFC"), end = c("top", "bottom"),
                             d = resid_df, cfg = CFG_RESID, save = TRUE) {
  family <- match.arg(family)
  end    <- match.arg(end)
  m   <- paste0("m", family)
  a   <- paste0("a", family)
  res <- paste0("resid_", family)

  tab <- d %>%
    arrange(if (end == "top") desc(.data[[res]]) else .data[[res]]) %>%
    slice_head(n = cfg$n) %>%
    select(player_name, routes, targets, pctl_m = all_of(m), pctl_a = all_of(a), resid = all_of(res))

  lim <- max(abs(tab$resid))
  what <- if (end == "top") "largest positive residuals: peak well above average (spiky)"
          else              "largest negative residuals: average closest to or above peak (sustained)"

  gt_tbl <- tab %>%
    gt() %>%
    tab_header(
      title    = md(paste0("**", if (end == "top") "Top " else "Bottom ", cfg$n, ": ", m, " - ", a,
                           " residual (2023)**")),
      subtitle = md(paste0(what, " | percentile points, routes-weighted across route groups | min ",
                           cfg$min_routes, " routes"))
    ) %>%
    cols_label(player_name = "Player", routes = "Routes", targets = "Targets",
               pctl_m = m, pctl_a = a, resid = paste0(m, " - ", a)) %>%
    fmt_number(columns = c(pctl_m, pctl_a), decimals = 1) %>%
    fmt_number(columns = resid, decimals = 1, force_sign = TRUE) %>%
    fmt_number(columns = c(routes, targets), decimals = 0) %>%
    data_color(columns = c(pctl_m, pctl_a), palette = RTE_PALETTE, domain = c(0, 100), na_color = "#EEEEEE") %>%
    data_color(columns = resid, palette = RTE_PALETTE, domain = c(-lim, lim), na_color = "#EEEEEE") %>%
    cols_align(align = "left", columns = player_name) %>%
    cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(routes, targets, pctl_m, pctl_a, resid)) %>%
    opt_row_striping() %>%
    tab_options(table.font.size = px(13), heading.title.font.size = px(16),
                column_labels.font.weight = "bold")

  if (save) gtsave(gt_tbl, filename = file.path(OUT_DIR,
                   paste0("residual_", m, "_minus_", a, "_", end, cfg$n, ".png")))
  gt_tbl
}

make_resid_table("RTE", "top")
make_resid_table("RTE", "bottom")
make_resid_table("OFC", "top")
make_resid_table("OFC", "bottom")
```


## 7b. Peak vs. average field control: mOFC against aOFC

Each point is one receiver with at least `CFG_RESID$min_routes` (200) routes in total, using the same routes-weighted combination of route-group percentiles as above (`resid_df`). The axes are zoomed to the 25th-75th percentiles (receivers outside that window are not drawn; the chunk reports how many). The dotted line is y = x: receivers on it have peak and average at the same percentile. Above the line the peak percentile exceeds the average percentile (labeled "Route runners"); below it the average exceeds the peak ("Speed separators"). The residual tables above rank how far each receiver is from the line.

```{r ofc-peak-vs-avg-scatter}
OFC_HIGHLIGHT <- c("DK Metcalf", "Amon-Ra St. Brown", "Brandin Cooks", "Garrett Wilson")  # names as in the dataset

missing_hl <- setdiff(OFC_HIGHLIGHT, resid_df$player_name)
if (length(missing_hl) > 0) {
  message("Not found among WRs with >= ", CFG_RESID$min_routes, " routes (check spelling / route minimum): ",
          paste(missing_hl, collapse = ", "))
}

ofc_pts <- resid_df %>% mutate(highlight = player_name %in% OFC_HIGHLIGHT)
ofc_hl  <- ofc_pts %>% filter(highlight)

AXIS_LIM <- c(25, 75)   # zoom window (percentiles) for both axes

outside <- ofc_pts %>% filter(!between(aOFC, AXIS_LIM[1], AXIS_LIM[2]) | !between(mOFC, AXIS_LIM[1], AXIS_LIM[2]))
message(nrow(outside), " of ", nrow(ofc_pts), " WRs fall outside the ", AXIS_LIM[1], "-", AXIS_LIM[2],
        " window and are not shown",
        if (any(outside$highlight)) paste0(" (including highlighted: ", paste(outside$player_name[outside$highlight], collapse = ", "), ")") else "",
        ".")

label_layer <- if (requireNamespace("ggrepel", quietly = TRUE)) {
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(data = ofc_hl, aes(label = player_name), fontface = "bold", size = 3.6,
                            box.padding = 0.7, min.segment.length = 0, max.overlaps = Inf,
                            color = "black", fill = "white")
} else {
  geom_text(data = ofc_hl, aes(label = player_name), fontface = "bold", size = 3.6, vjust = -1)
}

ofc_scatter <- ggplot(ofc_pts, aes(aOFC, mOFC)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = filter(ofc_pts, !highlight), color = "grey60", alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_point(data = ofc_hl, color = FAMILY_COLORS[["OFC"]], size = 4) +
  label_layer +
  annotate("text", x = AXIS_LIM[1] + 1, y = AXIS_LIM[2] - 1, label = "Route runners",
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 5, fontface = "bold", color = "grey35") +
  annotate("text", x = AXIS_LIM[2] - 1, y = AXIS_LIM[1] + 1, label = "Speed separators",
           hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 5, fontface = "bold", color = "grey35") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(AXIS_LIM[1], AXIS_LIM[2], 12.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(AXIS_LIM[1], AXIS_LIM[2], 12.5)) +
  coord_fixed(xlim = AXIS_LIM, ylim = AXIS_LIM) +     # zooms without dropping data from the geoms
  labs(title = "Peak vs. average offensive field control (mOFC vs. aOFC)",
       subtitle = paste0("Each point = one WR with at least ", CFG_RESID$min_routes,
                         " routes | percentiles within route group, routes-weighted | dotted line: y = x"),
       x = "aOFC (average-play field control percentile)",
       y = "mOFC (peak-frame field control percentile)") +
  theme_rte()

ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "mOFC_vs_aOFC_scatter.png"), ofc_scatter, width = 9, height = 9)
ofc_scatter
```
